mapping.summary: Rules-based sales agent commission calculation, accrual and settlement with agent hierarchies.
claims: Commission rules per agent, type and validity period, filtered by items, categories, dimensions, customers and price groups
Multi-level agent hierarchies of any depth with start and end dates
Commission can be based on invoiced or collected amounts
Commission rate follows the customer discount granted
Agents default from the hierarchy and can be overridden per header or line
Accruals and settlements run as scheduled background jobs
Two-stage ledger separates accrued from settled commissions
Entries trace to shipments, returns and the agent settlement invoice
Extensible through enums and events for partner adaptation
